question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e. **'Clouwn'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word among the options given is "Clouwn". The correct spelling is **"Clown".**
 
• **This word refers** to a comic entertainer, especially one in a circus, who wears a traditional costume and exaggerated makeup and performs comical acts.(जोकर)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Clouwn'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Treasure"** is spelled correctly. This word refers to a collection of valuable items such as money, jewels, gold, or other precious items.(खजाना)
 
• **"Poison"** is also spelled correctly. This refers to a substance that is capable of causing illness or death of a living organism when introduced or absorbed.(ज़हर)
 
• **"Mason" **is spelled correctly. This refers to a person who works with stone, brick, concrete, or a similar material, often in construction.(राजमिस्त्री)
